mapper.select: SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prj_task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prj_task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id AND t.status = 'DONE') AS done_count FROM prj_project p WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.status = #{status} ORDER BY p.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prj_project (project_code, name, owner_id, owner_name, status, start_date, end_date, description) VALUES (#{projectCode}, #{name}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE prj_project SET name=#{name}, owner_id=#{ownerId}, owner_name=#{ownerName}, status=#{status}, start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, description=#{description} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prj_task (project_id, title, description, assignee_id, assignee_name, priority, status, progress, due_date) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE prj_task SET status=#{status}, progress=#{progress} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM prj_task_comment WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prj_task_comment (task_id, user_id, user_name, content) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{content})
